result.instructions: Tools for Plutio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects do I have open for my clients, and which tasks are overdue?"; "List my unpaid invoices and what each client owes."; "Log 90 minutes on the 'Website redesign' task for me today.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Plutio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run plutio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run plutio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run plutio_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. plutio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

entityId.description: The _id of the contract, proposal or invoice.

tools.name: plutio_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: WRITE: add a person (a client by default) to the workspace. Returns the new record with its _id. POST /people.

role.description: Role: client (default) or one of your team roles.

tools.name: plutio_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: WRITE: add a company, optionally linking existing people to it. Returns the new record. POST /companies.

industry.description: Industry as Plutio's lowercase slug, e.g. design (a wrong value is rejected by Plutio).

personIds.description: _ids of existing people who work there.

tools.name: plutio_create_project
tools.title: Create project
tools.description: WRITE: create a project. Plutio gives it a default status and a first task board (find it with plutio_list_task_boards). Returns the new record. POST /projects.

clientId.description: _id of the client (a person or company) the project belongs to.

clientType.description: Whether clientId is a person (default) or a company.

startDate.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31T17:00:00Z.

dueDate.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31T17:00:00Z.

tools.name: plutio_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: add a task to a project's task board. Get taskBoardId from plutio_list_task_boards (projectId filter). New tasks start as incomplete. Returns the new record. POST /tasks.

projectId.description: The project the task belongs to.

taskBoardId.description: The task board inside that project.

taskGroupId.description: Optional task group (column) on the board.

dueDate.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31T17:00:00Z.

tools.name: plutio_update_task
tools.title: Update task
tools.description: WRITE: change a task's title, status (incomplete, completed, overdue), due date or description. Only the fields you pass change. Returns the updated record. PUT /tasks.

dueDate.description: An ISO 8601 date or date-time, e.g. 2026-12-31 or 2026-12-31T17:00:00Z.

tools.name: plutio_log_time
tools.title: Log time
tools.description: WRITE: record a time entry against a task. projectId must be the task's own project (read the task first). time is the length in seconds (5400 = 1.5 hours). POST /time-tracks.

taskId.description: The task the time was spent on.

entityType.description: Kind of record to comment on.

tools.title: Create event
tools.description: WRITE: add a calendar event. No invitations are sent. Returns the new record. POST /events.

tools.name: plutio_create_invoice
tools.title: Create draft invoice
tools.description: WRITE: create a DRAFT invoice for a person or company. The client cannot pay it and nothing is emailed. Add line items with plutio_add_invoice_items. Returns the new record. POST /invoices.

tools.description: WRITE: put line items on an invoice that has none yet (an invoice made with plutio_create_invoice). Refuses an invoice that already has an items block. Plutio works out line totals, subtotal and total. POST /blocks.
